blocks.html:
Fly-through conditions located 75 feet (22 860 mm) or less above grade shall be constructed with bird friendly materials.
(L.L. 2020/015, 1/10/2020, eff. 1/10/2021)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2020/015.
